analysis.title: Secure Remote Access Management
analysis.summary: A university remote access system must authenticate users, enforce role-based access controls, detect suspicious activity, generate alerts, and maintain audit logs to ensure secure off-campus access to internal systems.

assessments.explanation: The system must control off-campus access to university applications, servers, research systems, and administrative resources as a core security boundary.
Administrators must be able to define permissions, approve/revoke access, review active sessions, and terminate suspicious ones as defined operational actions.
Authentication, role-based restrictions, failed login detection, alert generation, and audit logging are required to meet security and reliability baselines.
The system must provide a centralized dashboard, integrate with identity services, support multiple campus locations, and maintain secure, reliable, scalable operation.

unresolved_decisions: What conditions define repeated authentication failures?
What conditions define unauthorized access attempts?
